[i][u]Official Statement from the Syndicalist Republic of Kaaganika[/u][/i]

We formally apologize for any inconveniences caused by this, but we relinquish our policy of allowing foreign vehicles on our territory due to the unexpected resilience of these Islamic terrorists, who have decided to go against our new syndicate and cause chaos to our workers and farmers, who simply wish to make their buck and live on.

We would also like to apologize to Sikirsk for our actions against you and your people, for we have come to a realization. A realization that neither the Kaiserreich nor the Sikirskans are in our interest. One seeks to spread corrupted capitalism across the continents, the other wishes to impose their dictatorial Kaiser as the hegemon of Elseyr. We are officially staying neutral in this conflict until the rebels are dealt with, whether by peace and diplomacy, or by force.

[b]Official Announcement from the Second Commonwealth of Jomsland[/b]

The Second Commonwealth of Jomsland announces its support for the Technocratic Empire in its war against the Grand Federation of Sikirsk. In compliance with our obligations to our elseyran brothers and sisters, the Second Commonwealth will extend the following forms of assistance effective immediately:

[i]- Deployment of Jomslandic cyberwarfare units to protect the Empires critical infrastructure and disrupt enemy cyberattacks.

- Provision of Jomslandic weaponry, including drones and thermobaric bombs, to reinforce military operations.

- Allocation of 3.5 billion Jomslandic króna in direct economic and logistical aid to support the Empires wartime economy[/i]

The Second Commonwealth stands with the Hochkaiser.

[b][i]Fortitudo per unitatem[/i][/b]
[nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation]
[nation]Sikirsk[/nation]
When and how did the Kaiserreich-Sikrisk war start?

[quote=italian_dutch;59807614]we sanctions on [nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation] only[/quote]

Understood! Thank you for clarifying for us :0

[spoiler=[b]Flottenverteidigung: Drones[/b]]

The carrier strike groups layered defense, completely unsuppressed, acted quickly to counter the submarine threat. The WOTAN-System or Weitreichendes Operations- und Trägersystem für Abwehr und Navigation designed by Kaiserliche Maschinenwerke AG was specifically designed to protect the Kaiserliche Marines fleets from missiles and aircraft. 

The SPY-1 and SPY-6 radar systems aboard the fleet are able to track hundreds of incoming missiles and aircraft at long ranges. Working with the Reichswehrs strategic satellites and airborne sensors such as the EK-70s systems, there is a constant flow of information to the fleet and command about threats such as the Sikirskian missiles. The CEC or Cooperative Engagement Capability allows the WOTAN to constantly track and identify potential threats. 

As the Sikirskian drone swarm tries to move towards the carrier strike group the AN/SPY-6 radars detect their locations. The Reichswehr, adapted to modern drone warfare, unleashes its vast arsenal of defenses against the swarm. Kinetic weapons such as the Heliginshild CIWS sprays 4,500 rounds per minute into the drone swarm, rapidly decreasing their ranks at a long distance. 

However, the Heiliginschild is far from the only weapon in the Kaiserliche Marines arsenal. HELIOS laser systems precisely hit drones with directed energy and help bring them out of the sky as well. High power radiation systems including the THOR aboard the fleet with the ability to fry the electronics of entire drone swarms are deployed as well. The signal between the operator and drone can be traced as well. The location of the operators are sent to the TKS Seelöwe carrier strike group who quickly retaliate by launching several Donnerkeil cruise missiles to their location. 

On the electronic warfare front, the Reichswehr also begins to jam the communications link between the drones and the drones and operators to block control signals and GPS navigation. Spoofing is also undertaken, with the Reich Cyberverteidigung sending false signals to crash or mislead the drones. 

Defensive drone swarms as well are deployed against the Sikirskian drone swarm. The RAE system dispatches friendly UAVs towards to the swarm to destroy and confuse the enemy drone swarms. RAE, fully autonomous and utilizing artificial learning algorithms, helps predict drone behavior and organizes responses in real time without requiring human in the loop input.[/spoiler] 

[spoiler=[b]Flottenverteidigung: Anti-Missile[/b]]

The powerful SPY-1 and SPY-6 radars quickly detect the presence of the anti-ship missiles as they approach the fleet. Using the flow of real time data, the WOTAN prioritizes threats and dispatches the necessary defenses to intercept them. WOTAN will make it extremely difficult for the missiles to even get close to the fleet, creating several layers of missile defense to protect the carrier from strikes. 

The first layer involves the Ff-4 missile interceptor designed for intercepting missiles from ballistics to hypersonic glide vehicles. Reaching up to 250 km in range, the Ff-4 is able to dynamically maneuver and chase hypersonics as they approach. In the improbable scenario that the missiles are able to pass the Ff-4 layer without saturation, the three other layers kick in. The Ff-3 possesses the ability to intercept high-speed and high-altitude threats against the fleet. 

Even if the missiles somehow pass through the Ff-4 and Ff-3, midlayer defense with the SM-2 goes into play. These interceptors can hit most surviving missiles that passed through the other two layers. Using a vertical launch system they rocket up and use their INS, guided by the WOTAN to intercept incoming projectiles. 

In the rare event that the incoming projectiles launched from the submarines somehow pass all three layers of missile defense the wide array of short range defense comes into effect. The ESSM is launched at a range of 50 km, its light and highly maneuverable frame allow it to hit maneuvering and hypersonic missiles especially sea-skimming ones. Radar guided Heilignshild CIWS fire their rounds and missiles at close ranges as well towards incoming missile threats. The 4,500 round per minute gatling guns aboard the CIWS provide a strong last layer of defense. 

If the missiles pass through the ESSM and Heilignshild the Kaiserliche Marine deploys its Nulka defenses. These radar deceptors mimic the signature of a ship, deceiving incoming missiles to move away as chaff and flares are sprayed to create false radar and infared targets. All the while the guided missile cruisers, destroyers and other ships in the CSG are positioned to provide overlapping layers of fire to maximize interception. 

In the end, the layered WOTAN system serves the Kaiserliche Marine well. While the main carrier is mostly unharmed save for some minor damage on the deck, a patrol boat is struck and heavily damaged. The TKS Seeschlange patrol boat will be sent back to drydock in Neudresden under escort while the rest of the carrier strike group continues its duties.[/spoiler] 

[spoiler=[b]Die Jäger jagen[/b]]

Now that the submarines have surfaced to launch their missile payloads the Kaiserlich Marine works quickly to ensure that the hunters quickly become the hunted. 

The fact they were close enough to use decoy torpedoes gives the Reichswehr a massive advantage. 

The passive sonar aboard the ships constantly listen for anything out of the ordinary that might be a sign of submarines. Propeller cavitation, machinery, anything out of the ordinary would be picked up. Another means of detection, the active sonar, sends out pings to locate the subs. These sonars, utilized by the ASW ships, Kaiserliche Marine nuclear subs, anti-submarine aircraft and Seewolf class helicopters cast a net to detect the submarines before they can leave. 

The Kaiserreichs sound surveillance system, a grouping of hydrophones that detect subs over long distances, also helps the Reich search. 

Once they are found by the vast array of Reichswehr eyes anti-submarine rockets are launched from surface craft to deliver both torpedoes and depth charges to the enemy submarines. Utilizing UUV swarms, the Kaiserlich Marine uses autonomous systems to attack the submarines as well. Each of the UUVs cost less than a single torpedo, with the UUVs utilizing torpedoes and their sheer numbers to attack the subs.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Die Offensive geht weiter[/b]]

As the majority of missiles are intercepted and ASROCs and UUVs hunt down the Sikirskian subs, the ground offensive continues as the Reichswehr moves to secure the entire island. Air superiority and a total blockade has been established, severely limiting the ability of the Sikirskians and their allies to defend themselves. 

The Reichswehr will exploit this massive weakness to the maximum extent. Batteries of AA missiles and Donnerkeil cruise missiles have been brought ashore to extend air superiority. Entrenched AA, radars and a growing Kaiserliche air presence have completely secured air space to favor the Reichswehr. The AA systems continue to send interceptors into the skies to hit the remaining Sikirskian aircraft as they run away. 

With the REG-3000s already having been dispatched against remaining Sikirskian AA, fifth generation J-22s enter Nestor-Sikirskian airspace to hunt the remaining Sikirskian aircraft. Using before-visual-range AAMs they fire towards the enemy aircraft as the AA joins them. Their datalink capabilities allow them to control missiles from the J-16s as well allowing them to maximize the amount of AAMs being fired towards the fleeing Sikirskians. 

The Donnerkeils continue their work. Hundreds of them fly from the Kaiserliche Marines surface craft as well as from the southwest portion of the island controlled by the Kaiserreich. They fly low to avoid radar detection and slam into the remaining Sikirskian positions. Hitting Sikirskian tanks, vehicles, command centers, military infrastructure and logistics hub they aim to continue to destroy the Sikirskian ability to wage ground warfare. JDAMs from J-16s and J-15EX strike reichsadlers are dropped onto Nestor-Sikirskian runways, aircraft and aviation fuels on top of troops. To prevent the Sikirskians from effectively waging a counterattack, bridges, roads and railroads are also hit by precision guided munitions. 

By this time, with significant air support, the heavy arms of the Kaiserliche Armee have arrived onto the island. A force of 190,000 has been established with the Marineinfantrie and Kaiserliche Armee pushing further north as their opponents are bombed by all manner of munitions from cruise missiles to JDAMs. Utilizing their infantry fighting vehicles and heavy tanks they push north fast.[/spoiler]

[/i][/u][/b]
[b]Location: Grand Yugorsk, Sikirsk
[/b]Unit: 3rd Signals Warfare Group
Time: 02:41 AM

Weve managed to find one of the enemys radio networks. They dont know were coming in. Were listening from deep inside the Grand Yugorsk command bunker using a Long range, K-113 Specter antenna, and a Phantom drone circling off the coast to boost the signal.

Right now, were hearing scraps of:

-A convoy asking for fuel

-A commander calling for help near Eurosk Ridge

-An AA team moving their launcher

[i]We shall see what we can do.
[/i]

[nation]Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/nation][/quote]
[spoiler=[b]FHSS[/b]]
The enemy would only receive small pieces of information. Some of it is almost nonsensical from the encryption. Their access to communications is an extremely rare event. The Reichswehr heavily regulates how its members communicate. Information is typically relayed in small and short bursts rather than a constant stream to reduce the chances of enemy interception. The highly directional antennas of the Reichswehr also heavily limit who can access the radio communications. The signals are also spread over a wide spectrum to look like background noise. 

But at rare times such as this others can access some information. The Sikirskians would be able to listen in for a couple seconds, listening to heavily encoded means of communication before it just stops. The FHSS or frequency hopping spread spectrum is constantly at work: constantly changing frequencies used in a random manner making interception extremely improbable. 
[/spoiler]

[b][i]Official Order from Joanna Sźekely, Duchess of Tel Scadu[/i][/b]

The Scaduan Congress and I have finally decided on a course of action for the Kaiserreich-Sikirskan war. We are concerned over the Kaissereichs growing power, and are very worried over the potential of Kaiserreich hegemony over the continent. We have decided to give Sikirsk some of our resources to help them reach back to their status quo, to a time when Elseyr was once peaceful.
The following orders will be carried out

-20 million crowns will be sent to Sikirsk to help pay for their expenses of defense.

-Ships carrying ammunition will be continually deployed and sent to Sikirskan ports, however the route to Sikirsk is quite long considering we have to leave our lake through a river leading to the southern strait, so these will be coming slowly.

-One destroyer, the TSNV Cśatar, is armed with twin 3-inch cannons and guided missiles, among other things. We are giving this to you for the time being in hopes of helping you defend you and Nestor-Sikirsks territorial integrity, however this is also our only naval vessel, so we ask you treat it with care.

We hope this helps your military rest a little easier, even if it is minor help.
